role: Defines Layer 2/Layer 3 boundary contracts for perception pipeline observations and bounding boxes
detail: BoundingBox models pixel-space detection coordinates (x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max) with frame dimensions; provides computed properties (center_x, center_y, width, height, area_fraction). Observation is the primary immutable data structure crossing perception->knowledge-graph boundary, capturing detected label, confidence (0.0-1.0), bounding_box, optional embedding/dominant_colors, UTC timestamp, provenance (SENSOR), and optional candidate_node_id for KG node matching. Both models are frozen (BaseModel with ConfigDict frozen=True). _utc_now() factory returns timezone-aware UTC datetime. Validators enforce x_min < x_max, y_min < y_max, positive frame dimensions. Observations represent immutable facts; corrections create new observations.
gotchas: embedding and dominant_colors are optional, deferred to later phases; candidate_node_id is None if no KG match attempted; detections may extend slightly outside frame boundaries (not clamped)
